# KL Servis Rumah

> Market-rate painting, plumbing, ceiling, waterproofing, handyman, electrical, renovation, cleaning, security and home-improvement services for Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, Malaysia.

## Core pages

- https://www.klservisrumah.my/ — Homepage and instant booking entry point.
- https://www.klservisrumah.my/services — Full service directory for 28 home-service pillars.
- https://www.klservisrumah.my/pricing — Transparent market-rate price guide.
- https://www.klservisrumah.my/areas — Klang Valley service-area directory.
- https://www.klservisrumah.my/problems — Diagnostic problem/solution hub.
- https://www.klservisrumah.my/tools — Free calculators and triage tools.
- https://www.klservisrumah.my/contact — Booking form and dispatch contact.

## Coverage

KL Servis Rumah serves Kuala Lumpur and Selangor including Kuala Lumpur, Cheras, Ampang, Setapak, Wangsa Maju, Kepong, Sri Petaling, Bukit Jalil, Mont Kiara, Bangsar, Desa ParkCity, Taman Melawati, Petaling Jaya, SS2, Bandar Utama, Damansara, Kota Damansara, Ara Damansara, Subang Jaya, Sunway, USJ, Puchong, Shah Alam, Setia Alam, Kota Kemuning, Klang, Batu Caves, Selayang, Rawang, Sungai Buloh, Kajang, Semenyih, Seri Kembangan, Pandan Indah, Putrajaya, Cyberjaya and Sentul.

## Pricing principle

All public prices follow standard Malaysian market rates: not inflated, not artificially underpriced, and confirmed in an itemised quote before work starts.
